name: Bizinta
description_en:
Bizinta combines timekeeping, expenses, project reporting, billing and resource scheduling for consulting and professional-services firms. Its product model follows people’s time into client economics; it is broader than a standalone stopwatch.

Modules and active-user types have separate charges. A firm evaluating only time entry should not assume it also receives every scheduling, billing, skills or management function at the entry price.
description_zh:
Bizinta 为咨询与专业服务公司组合工时、费用、项目报告、计费及资源排程。产品模型将人员投入关联到客户经济结果，范围大于独立计时器。

模块及活跃用户类型分别收费。只评估时间录入的公司，不能默认入门价格包含所有排程、计费、技能或管理功能。

core_features.explanation_zh: Basic 列出计时器及行级工时审批。

core_features.explanation_zh: 独立模块可从工时表生成发票并计划资源容量。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: approved consulting time to an invoice
sections.title_zh: 示例：咨询工时审批后生成发票
sections.en:
Define clients, projects, staff and billing/pay rates. A consultant records time, an approver checks the line and billing uses accepted data. Scheduling and actual time answer different questions: planned availability does not prove work was delivered. Reconcile an edited or rejected line before producing the client invoice.

This is a suggested evaluation, not a performed accounting integration. Check which module and permission allows each actor to see rates and profitability; not every timesheet user should automatically receive financial-administration access.
sections.zh:
定义客户、项目、人员及计费/支付费率。顾问记工时、审批人检查行，计费使用已接受数据。计划与实际回答不同问题：预排可用时间不证明工作已交付。生成客户发票前，应核对被修改或拒绝的行。

这是评估建议，未执行财务集成。应检查每个角色查看费率及利润所需的模块/权限，不能默认所有工时用户都具财务管理访问。

sections.title_en: Active usage, required management account and add-ons
sections.title_zh: 活跃用量、必需管理账户与附加项
sections.en:
The price page lists Basic timekeeping at $11 per active timesheet user monthly, Advanced $18 and Enterprise $23 for broader time/expense/project roles. Reporting/admin users are $39 monthly with at least one required. Scheduling lists $13 per active user; integrated billing starts at $49 monthly, with transaction fees stated separately. The page says the displayed prices include a five-percent auto-pay discount.

It recalculates active-user billing monthly, with the FAQ referring to people who filled a timesheet. Clarify different module activation rules, billing-volume tiers, currency and taxes in a quote. Do not add stray legacy/dynamic price tokens in the HTML into the total or assume a free plan from a demo invitation.
sections.zh:
定价页列 Basic 每活跃工时用户每月 $11、Advanced $18、Enterprise $23，后者对应更多时间/费用/项目角色。报告/管理员每月 $39，至少需要一位。排程每活跃用户 $13，集成计费每月 $49 起，交易费另列。页面表示显示价格已含自动扣款百分之五折扣。

活跃用户费用按月重算，FAQ 提到填写工时表的人。应在报价中明确不同模块激活规则、计费量档、货币及税费，不能把 HTML 遗留/动态碎片金额相加，也不能从演示邀请推定免费档。

sections.en:
Prepare client/project IDs, approval paths, rate history, accounting mappings and opening balances. Inspect approved time and invoice references before retrying a failed sync, otherwise a corrected timesheet can become duplicate billing. No exact recovery semantics or accounting compatibility was tested.

Consulting operations teams can evaluate the connected workflow. A personal focus timer or general manufacturing ERP requirement is different. The read material describes a commercial online service; full licence, self-hosting, data retention and restoration were not verified.
sections.zh:
准备客户/项目标识、审批路径、历史费率、财务映射及期初余额。同步失败重试前先检查已审批工时及发票引用，避免更正工时变成重复计费。未测试具体恢复规则或财务兼容性。

咨询运营团队可评估关联流程，个人专注计时或通用制造 ERP 属于不同需求。材料介绍商业在线服务，完整许可、自托管、保留及恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Module activation, accounting sync/retry, currency/tax, security, software licence and restoration need quote/account checks.
research_gaps.zh: 模块激活、财务同步/重试、货币/税费、安全、软件许可及恢复需报价/账户确认。
